a0.note: A_0's fillers are TRAIN and KC-S1b already sent every one of them, so any 6-gram they share with a devel sentence is exempt: refusing it would refuse the incumbent itself. A filler shorter than six words yields no 6-gram at all, which is why this count is small.

bound_by: Coordinator decision 5 of 2026-09-06: DEV-1000 sentence text only, as 6-gram sets only. SLURP-DEV-500-B-V1 and the test split are never named, loaded or opened by this artifact or by the script that built it.
what_this_is: The evaluation side of the EVO-S1 decontamination gate: the word 6-grams of the DEV-1000 devel sentences, as SHA-256 digests of the space-joined gram. Digests and never grams, because a committed file of literal 6-grams would be six-word windows of devel sentence text written into the repository. rails.proposer.load_evaluation_ngram_digests reads this file and rails.proposer.validate_slurp_candidate_artifact compares candidate FILLER digests against it, exempting any digest A_0's own TRAIN fillers already carry.
